rules.title: Discriminatory content
rules.summary: Racist, sexist, anti-LGBTQ+, or antisemitic content

rules.title: Player character attack
rules.summary: Attacks on a player's character, family, or personal life

rules.title: Coach / ref / official attack
rules.summary: Personal attacks on coaches, refs, or officials

rules.title: Pure personal news
rules.summary: Divorce, relationships, family — no league conduct dimension

rules.title: News digest personal attack
rules.summary: Same rule 3/5 standard applied to news commentary

rules.summary: Same signature phrasing as recent consecutive days

rules.title: Off-roster player
rules.summary: Implies current team membership for non-roster players
